situation.unseen: The intersection of US missile depletion, 600+ undisclosed casualties, and Zelenskyy offering Ukraine satellite intelligence on Iran is a three-way signal that the US is already operating in a quiet coalition wartime posture against Iran that has not been publicly acknowledged — the political and strategic blowback when this becomes undeniable will be severe and rapid, and the prediction markets show zero pricing of this risk
situation.criticalWindow: The 30-60 day window following the US strike halt is the most dangerous: Iran and the Houthis will test the pause with graduated provocations, US magazine depth must be assessed and resupply ordered before any credible resumption of deterrence, and Netanyahu's Washington visit is the decisive diplomatic moment where Israeli operational autonomy versus US restraint gets negotiated — failure here risks Israeli unilateral action that re-engages the US before it is ready
watchFor: Iranian direct or proxy attack on US forces or Gulf infrastructure within 30 days as a test of the strike pause
Official or leaked confirmation of the 600+ casualty figure triggering congressional hearings and constraining presidential war authority
Saudi-Houthi ceasefire or capitulation signaling Riyadh's assessment that US cover is unreliable, with downstream OPEC production-cut risk
Chinese naval or air activity near Taiwan or in the South China Sea spiking while US carrier assets and munitions stocks are stretched in CENTCOM
situation.confidenceNote: Key uncertainties are severe: the casualty database headline is unverified and could be inflated or mischaracterized; the missile shortage claim has no sourcing detail and could reflect a single system rather than systemic depletion; Kalshi 2028 election markets reflect speculative positioning three years out and carry minimal predictive weight on near-term policy; GDELT Middle East and Indo-Pacific feeds are notably thin in this snapshot, which itself may indicate active information suppression around ongoing operations
situation.topPattern: The central strategic pattern is a concealed wartime operational ceiling: the US has apparently conducted a sustained military campaign against Iran that generated 600+ casualties and exhausted critical munitions stocks, all without a formal war declaration or public accounting — Kalshi markets show zero pricing of impeachment or removal above 16% and no elevated conflict-resolution contracts, meaning the market has not yet integrated the operational constraint signal, and when it does, the repricing across energy, defense, and political contracts will be simultaneous and sharp

signals.headline: Pentagon logs 600+ Iran war casualties amid US missile shortage constraints
signals.summary: Quiet database update reveals sustained kinetic operations against Iranian targets, but parallel reporting of US munitions depletion suggests operational tempo may be unsustainable. Tehran escalating with graphic revenge threats, signaling intent to widen conflict.
signals.signal: US pursuing degradation strategy against Iran but constrained by attrition of precision munitions inventory; Iranian response asymmetry (billboards, proxy activation) indicates Tehran prepared for long conflict. Implies potential shift to less-precise or proxy-centric operations if shortage persists.
signals.contradicts: Official statements of measured, controlled posture in Persian Gulf

signals.headline: Kamala Harris 2028 Democratic nomination odds collapse to 10% despite recent baseline
signals.summary: Harris nomination probability flat-lined at 10 cents with massive volume (252k contracts), while Gavin Newsom surged to 17% (+1¢) and Jon Ossoff holds 14%. No incumbent co-party advantage despite recent proximity to power.
signals.signal: Democratic field fracturing away from obvious successor; Newsom, AOC (15%), and centrist Ossoff fragmenting vote. Suggests deep party ambivalence about Harris viability or active consolidation behind alternative candidates. Open nomination despite unified government control.
signals.contradicts: Historical pattern of sitting-party incumbent or VP-adjacent frontrunning in nominally favorable conditions

signals.headline: Zelenskyy pledges exclusive Ukraine satellite intelligence to NATO/US for Iran operations
signals.summary: Ukraine offering classified ISR resources to support US/NATO against Iran theater operations. Signal of deepening Ukraine-US integration on non-European theaters and potential trade of intelligence for continued military aid.
signals.signal: Kyiv signaling willingness to operationalize intelligence sharing on Middle East conflicts in exchange for sustained support on Russian front. Implies US-Ukraine relationship expanding beyond territorial defense to global power competition. May indicate Ukrainian calculation that Iran escalation benefits deterrence calculus vs. Russia.
signals.contradicts: Assumption that Ukraine primarily inward-focused; demonstrates Kyiv's global strategic agency

signals.headline: Todd Blanche Attorney General odds at 85% despite Hegseth confidence erosion across Cabinet
signals.summary: Trump's AG nominee consolidating exceptional confidence (85 cents, -3¢ but from higher base) while Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth facing eroding confidence signals. Cabinet stability concerns not extending uniformly.
signals.signal: Blanche's legal background and prosecutorial credibility appear insulating him from broader Cabinet turbulence affecting less-institutional nominees. Suggests market pricing institutional gravitas differently than media-facing loyalty metrics. Legal function outweighing political loyalty in this pick.
signals.contradicts: Assumption that all Trump Cabinet picks face uniform confirmation/confidence risk

signals.headline: President advancing nuclear energy agenda; family/supporter financial exposure under scrutiny
signals.summary: Administration pushing aggressive nuclear expansion policy while media flags potential conflicts of interest regarding beneficiaries. Public record interest in financial linkages between policy actors and nuclear sector.
signals.signal: Nuke policy likely to accelerate under current administration; profit opportunities embedded in regulatory/subsidy regime. Watch for: nuclear finance deals, uranium market moves, and energy sector insider trading patterns as policy framework clarifies.

signals.headline: Brazil's right-wing party nominates Bolsonaro son as Lula opposition candidate
signals.summary: Conservative coalition consolidating behind Bolsonaro family continuity rather than new-generation leadership. Move signals durability of populist-right opposition to Lula's leftist governance in largest LATAM economy.
signals.signal: Brazil's political polarization hardening along familiar axes rather than resolution or realignment. Implications for US-Brazil relations on trade, Amazon policy, and regional alignment neutral-to-negative for current US administration priorities. Multipolarity risk in Western Hemisphere.

groundTruth.headline: Pentagon confirms 600+ Iranian war casualties in quiet database update; Tehran issues graphic revenge threats
groundTruth.summary: US-Iran indirect conflict has reached measurable casualty levels. Tehran's escalating rhetoric and visual threats indicate preparation for direct retaliation, likely against Gulf infrastructure, Israel, or US military presence. Timing unclear but window appears compressed.
groundTruth.signal: US must assume Iranian strike within 2-4 weeks; force protection critical for all CENTCOM assets, regional allies, and shipping chokepoints; Israel coordination essential

groundTruth.headline: USA halts strikes amid missile shortage; operational constraints now visible
groundTruth.summary: Munitions depletion is forcing operational pauses in active theater. This reveals logistics vulnerability and constrains US ability to respond to Iranian moves or support allies (Houthis, Saudi escalation ongoing).
groundTruth.signal: Adversaries will recognize windows of reduced US strike capacity; allies lose confidence in sustained support; domestic munitions industrial base inadequate for peer conflict

groundTruth.headline: Zelenskyy pledges exclusive Ukraine satellite intelligence to NATO/USA for Iran operations
groundTruth.summary: Ukraine offering real-time or near-real-time overhead/signals intelligence to US for Middle East targeting. Signals tightening US-Ukraine-NATO integration and Ukraine's desire to remain relevant and leveraged post-conflict.
groundTruth.signal: US gains persistent ISR asset for Iran/Gulf monitoring; Ukraine operationalizes strategic value as deterrent against abandonment; creates intelligence dependency and alliance stickiness

groundTruth.headline: Confidence in Hegseth eroding; cabinet confirmation viability at risk
groundTruth.summary: Trump's SecDef nominee facing confirmation headwinds. If withdrawn or rejected, creates defense leadership vacuum during Iran crisis and broader restructuring of military command.
groundTruth.signal: Potential paralysis at Pentagon during active Middle East threat window; allies/adversaries read US domestic turmoil as distraction; military readiness continuity at risk

groundTruth.headline: Democratic 2028 nominee market fragmented: Harris 10%, Newsom 17%, Ossoff 14%, AOC 15%
groundTruth.summary: No clear Democratic frontrunner 18 months pre-nomination. Market prices suggest open race with 5-6 viable candidates splitting field. Prediction-market consensus remains deeply uncertain.
groundTruth.signal: Dem party lacks messaging discipline on foreign policy (Iran, Ukraine, Israel); GOP maintains cohesion behind Trump (3% general-election odds but dominant in nomination); expect contested convention dynamics by mid-2027
